comparison.objective: Remove and recover HELICOIL tangs; record clamps an aluminum bar and drills a marked through-hole.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial mandrel stabilization and controlled hammer blows; record requires clamp tightening, workpiece restraint, and drill-feed operation with hand clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four notch fractures, retained inserts, and all fragments in a tray; record requires a correctly located hole while clamped, drill retracted, and no unsafe approach. Candidate force/damage thresholds remain unspecified.
comparison.reason: Impact fracture of internal tangs and loose-fragment recovery are meaningfully different from workholding and drill feeding.
